description: Three shaping stages fed from one common input plus an input of their own, mixed together and blended back with the dry signal

params.text: Sets how hard stage A shapes what reaches it, 1 down to -0.4.
Sets how hard stage B shapes what reaches it, 0 to 1.
Sets how hard stage C shapes what reaches it, -1 to 1.
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at that stage's CV input before it adds to the stage's SHAPE setting.
Attenuates the three shaping stages mixed together, before they reach the dry and wet blend.
Crossfades the output from the four inputs summed to the shaped signal.

inputs.text: Added to IN A, IN B and IN C in turn, so it passes through all three shaping stages.
Shifts the SHAPE A setting through the CV 1 attenuverter.
Shifts the SHAPE B setting through the CV 2 attenuverter.
Shifts the SHAPE C setting through the CV 3 attenuverter.
Summed with IN M and fed to shaping stage A.
Summed with IN M and fed to shaping stage B.
Summed with IN M and fed to shaping stage C.

outputs.text: The shaped signal and the summed inputs blended by MIX, soft-clipped.
